notes: Service-fee values reflect Pricing v3 v2.2 (shipped 2026-04-09) — single service-fee recipient, low-ADA fixed fees, plus a tiered commission percentage on project rewards.
Service fees synced from andamio-dev-kit-internal/configs/andamio-atlas/preprod/fee-config.json (atlas preprod config).

transactionCosts and minUtxoByType were captured from decoded preprod CBORs in 2025-12 — execution units, deposits, and walletDeltas are still valid empirical data. Where a transactionCosts entry embeds a serviceFee value, the top-level serviceFees / commissionTiers blocks are authoritative if they disagree.
Values are in lovelace unless noted (1 ADA = 1,000,000 lovelace).
Min UTxO depends on datum/token size — these are observed values, not constants.
Tx fees depend on script execution units — they vary by transaction.
walletDelta = actual change to wallet balance (positive = cost, negative = gain).
Mainnet may differ. Preprod is the reference here. Verify against mainnet fee-config before quoting production costs.

transactionCosts.note: Empirical exec-units and deposits remain valid; embedded serviceFee values may be stale and should be cross-checked against top-level serviceFees.

serviceFeeRecipient.description: Unified service-fee recipient address in Pricing v3. All course and project service fees are paid here.

previousAddresses.note: Earlier versions of this registry referenced separate protocol-treasury and instance-treasury addresses. Those were deprecated when the v3 fee model shipped — a single recipient now handles both surfaces.

mint-access-token.note: v3: no service fee output for access token minting. Confirmed in devkit/docs/tx-flows/access-token-mint.md.

course-create.note: v3: flat 1 ADA service fee. Previous '100 ADA base + 10 ADA × teachers' formula is gone.

course-teachers-update.note: v3: flat 1 ADA service fee per teacher update.

assignment-update.note: No service fee for assignment updates.

credential-claim.note: No service fee for course credential claim.

project-create.note: v3: flat 1 ADA service fee. Previous '100 ADA base + 10 ADA × managers' formula is gone.

project-managers-update.note: v3: flat 1 ADA service fee. (Atlas calls this 'addProjectCreators'.)

project-blacklist-manage.note: No service fee for blacklist management.

project-tasks-manage.note: No service fee for task management.

project-task-commit.note: No service fee on commit. Commission applies at reward claim — see commissionTiers.

project-tasks-assess.note: No service fee for task assessment.

project-credential-claim.note: v3: replaced flat 1 ADA fee with a minimum-plus-percentage model. commission_rate comes from the project's CommissionRate column (default 0.05). See commissionTiers.

commissionTiers.description: Percentage commission applied on contributor reward claims. The percentage is stored on the project as a float (Project.CommissionRate, NUMERIC(5,4)). Tier names are display labels only.

powerUpFlow.note: Upgrade tier by paying an ADA TX to serviceFeeRecipient with metadata { type: 'power_up', project_id, target_tier }. Verified by gateway via andamioscan.

apiInjection.note: Gateway intercepts /v2/project/task/commit and /v2/project/credential/claim, looks up commission_rate from db-api, and injects fee_rate into the Atlas request. Caller-supplied fee_rate is stripped.

general.mint-access-token.serviceFeeNote: v3: no service fee on this route (previously 5 ADA to protocol-treasury).

spent.notes: Existing index node recycled - ADA returned to transaction

utxoFlow.notes: Net = created - spent portion used for new UTxOs

walletDelta.breakdown: txFee (0.36) + netUtxoChange (2.51) — service fee removed in v3
walletDelta.verified: v3-adjusted from 2025-12 measurement; re-verify against current preprod

course.admin.create.serviceFeeNote: v3: flat 1 ADA, no longer scales with teacher count. Was '100 ADA + 10 ADA × teachers'.

utxoDeposits.notes: LocalStateToken includes embedded script_ref (~16.5 ADA). Deposit does not scale with teacher count.

totalCost.note: v3 total is flat regardless of teacher count (deposits and fee both fixed).

utxoDeposits.notes: Per module - scales with number of modules minted

course.student.enroll.notes: With single assignment commitment. Deposit recoverable on credential-claim.

course.student.assignment-update.notes: MinUTxO increases when datum grows (longer assignment_info)

course.teacher.assignments-assess.notes: Datum shrinks (pending→completed), so teacher gets partial refund

course.student.credential-claim.notes: NEGATIVE = student gains ADA. Burned course state UTxO releases enrollment deposit.

instance.owner.project.create.serviceFeeNote: v3: flat 1 ADA, no longer scales with manager count. Was '100 ADA + 10 ADA × managers'.

utxoDeposits.notes: LocalStateToken includes embedded script_ref (~15 ADA), TreasuryScript includes embedded script_ref (~20 ADA)

totalCost.note: v3 total is flat regardless of manager count.

instance.owner.project.create.notes: Complex transaction with 6 mints, 2 observers, stake registration. Includes treasury system with embedded script references.

project.owner.managers.manage.notes: Identical pattern to course.owner.teachers.manage - same validators, same fee structure.

utxoDeposits.notes: Spend-and-recreate with observer pattern - no new UTxOs

project.owner.contributor-blacklist.mana.notes: No protocol fee for blacklist management. Uses project-state-observer for validation.

utxoDeposits.notes: Task escrow holds the reward amount; no fixed deposit

totalCost.breakdown: txFee only - deposit goes to treasury/escrow

project.manager.tasks.manage.notes: No minting - uses existing treasury-tokens. Execution units scale with number of tasks.

utxoDeposits.notes: Contributor-state deposit is largest - holds enrollment data. Some deposits may come from task-escrow UTxOs.

walletDelta.notes: Actual cost depends on existing UTxOs consumed from task escrow. First enrollment has higher cost due to contributor-state token mint.

totalCost.breakdown: Most deposit comes from task escrow deposit UTxO

project.contributor.task.commit.notes: MINTS contributor-state token on first enrollment. Complex transaction with global-state update, task-escrow spending, and observer validation. Includes prerequisite verification in mint redeemer.

project.manager.tasks.assess.notes: No minting - spend and recreate pattern. Analogous to course.teacher.assignments.assess.

project.contributor.credential.claim.serviceFeeNote: v3: replaces flat 1 ADA with min-or-percentage. Default commission_rate is 0.05 (5%); see commissionTiers for tiers.

walletDelta.ada: ~-13 ADA (NET GAIN at default tier with no reward)
walletDelta.verified: Empirical from 2025-12; v3 fee dynamics may shift this when reward is non-trivial.
walletDelta.withReward: Effective wallet delta = depositRefund + reward × (1 - commission_rate) - txFee - max(1 ADA, commission_rate × reward)

project.contributor.credential.claim.notes: BURNS contributor-state token. Contributor gets NET GAIN from released deposit. Service fee is the larger of 1 ADA or commission_rate × reward.

index-node.description: Index linked list node with datum + space token

global-state-v2.description: Global state UTxO with datum + g-token

local-state-token.description: LocalStateToken UTxO with courseId datum + embedded script_ref

course-governance.description: Course governance UTxO with teachers list datum

module.description: Module UTxO with course/teachers datum + module token

access-token-wallet.description: User wallet UTxO holding access token

course-state-pending.description: Course state UTxO with pending assignment datum (constructor 1)

course-state-completed.description: Course state UTxO with completed assignment datum (constructor 0)

contributor-state-active.description: Contributor state UTxO with active task commitment datum (constructor 1)

course.credential.description: Complete loop: enroll → commit assignment → assess → claim credential

student.notes: Enrollment deposit partially recovered on credential claim. No service fees on either side.

teacher.notes: Datum compression gives small refund vs raw tx fee

course.credential.notes: Assumes single assignment commitment at enrollment. Additional assignment-updates add ~0.33 ADA each.

course.credential.with-updates.description: Loop with assignment updates: enroll → update → update → assess → claim
course.credential.with-updates.formula: student: ~1.11 + (N × ~0.33) where N = number of assignment updates

project.credential.description: Complete loop: contributor commits to task → manager assesses → contributor claims credential + ADA reward

costs.project-credential-claim: ~0.35 ADA fee + max(1 ADA, commission × reward) - ~14.5 ADA deposit refund

contributor.netCost: Net positive at claim due to deposit refund + reward × (1 - commission_rate)
contributor.notes: State deposit (~14.5 ADA) fully refunded at claim. Commission rate defaults to 5% — see commissionTiers.

project.credential.totalLoopCost: ~1.21 ADA in fees + max(1 ADA, commission × reward)
project.credential.breakdown: contributor fees (~0.86) + service fee (min 1 ADA) + manager (~0.35). Contributor net positive due to deposit refund + reward minus commission.
project.credential.prerequisite: Contributor must hold course credential (prerequisite gating). Project must have funded treasury.
project.credential.notes: Task reward from treasury, paid out minus commission. State deposit is ~14.5 ADA locked at commit, fully refunded at claim. See tx-loops.yaml loop #4 for full step sequence.
